assessments.reasoning: The instrument does not contain a dedicated set of questions to record unpaid domestic and care work per person. Domestic and care work appears only as a category of inactivity (Pregunta 7, option 2: 'Ama de casa / responsable de los quehaceres del hogar') or as a reason for not seeking work (Pregunta 6, option 11: 'LABORES DE CASA/CUIDADO DE MIEMBROS DEL HOGAR'). According to the indicator definition, mentioning domestic work only as a category of inactivity or a reason for not working does not count as recording domestic work through its own questions. Therefore, the proposition is false and domestic work is treated as other.
